original_description: Tiger Roar: a single real tiger call recorded at Louisville Zoo, Kentucky. Public high-quality MP3 version of Freesound recording 263115; source does not identify the tiger subspecies. Quiet lead-in and trailing ambience removed.
source_format_note: Downloaded an already trimmed/filtered/normalized/faded 96 kbps mono AAC derivative, not original 24-bit WAV. Source is a recorded tiger, not synthetic.
